_note: Fictional worked examples showing the expected structure and level of judgement.

examples.title: Single funding source
examples.description: The project relies on one grant; if it is delayed or reduced, work stops.
examples.quote: The project will be funded entirely by the grant.
examples.likelihood_reason: Grant decisions are usually made on time.
examples.impact_reason: A delay would stop work and add standing costs.

examples.title: Key person dependency
examples.description: Only one named person can run the specialist system; if they leave, operations stall.
examples.quote: The system is operated by the Technical Lead.
examples.impact_reason: Several weeks to recruit and train a replacement.

examples.title: Shared procurement
examples.description: Buying jointly with a partner could lower equipment prices.
examples.quote: Partners may combine purchasing where practical.

examples.title: Unlimited indemnity
examples.description: The organisation gives an indemnity with no upper limit.
examples.quote: The Organisation shall indemnify the Partner against all losses.
examples.impact_reason: A single claim could exceed the budget.

examples.title: Weather-dependent schedule
examples.description: Outdoor work is planned in winter; bad weather would delay it.
examples.impact_reason: Two to six weeks of delay.
